## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A time-sampled spatial motion stored as parallel arrays: Times[i] is the
// time since trajectory start, Positions[i] the position in meters, and
// Velocities[i] the velocity in meters per second. Velocities may be empty
// when unknown.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trajectory)
type Trajectory3D
    implements IValue
{
    Times: Array<Duration>;
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Velocities: Array<Vector3D>;
}

//==
// # Closed-form motions

// Projectile motion under constant gravity: position(t) = InitialPosition +
// InitialVelocity * t + Gravity * t^2 / 2. InitialVelocity is in meters per
// second; Gravity is a constant acceleration in meters per second squared.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Projectile_motion)
type BallisticTrajectory
    implements IValue
{
    InitialPosition: Point3D;
    InitialVelocity: Vector3D;
    Gravity: Vector3D;
}

// Motion at constant angular speed around a circle: the moving point orbits
// Center in the plane perpendicular to Axis at distance Radius, starting at
// phase InitialPhase.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_motion)
type UniformCircularMotion
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point3D;
    Axis: Direction3D;
    Radius: Length;
    AngularSpeed: AngularVelocity;
    InitialPhase: Angle;
}

// Sinusoidal oscillation of a scalar: value(t) = Offset + Amplitude *
// sin(AngularFrequency * t + Phase). Offset and Amplitude are in the units of
// the oscillating quantity (unit-agnostic).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simple_harmonic_motion)
type SimpleHarmonicMotion
    implements IValue
{
    Offset: Number;
    Amplitude: Number;
    AngularFrequency: AngularVelocity;
    Phase: Angle;
}

// The physical parameters of an ideal damped pendulum. Gravity is the local
// gravitational acceleration; Damping is the angular velocity decay rate in
// units of one per second (0 = undamped).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pendulum)
type Pendulum
    implements IValue
{
    ArmLength: Length;
    Gravity: Acceleration;
    Damping: Number;
}

// The instantaneous state of a pendulum: signed deflection from the rest
// (hanging) direction and its rate of change.
type PendulumState
    implements IValue
{
    Deflection: Angle;
    AngularVelocity: AngularVelocity;
}
```
